facts.fact: NCRA's Director General states that since March 2022 access to services including SIM card registration and e-KYC for financial institutions is linked to the National Identification Number of people enrolled in the CRVS and identity management system.

NCRA states that since March 2022 services in telecoms (SIM card registration), finance (e-KYC, credit reference checks), social security, tax, immigration, land, education and payroll are linked to the NIN; it says the voter register has been extracted from the civil register since 2018.
